items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was – that was Shorty Rogers. ... Yeah, Shorty Rogers and the Bud Shank and everything, that was up in Hollywood

ctx.x: Elmo – I used to go – Harold Land used to be over there a lot. Harold and Elmo used to write a lot of stuff, really unbelievable, intricate things. Elmo, he was something. A lot of people didn’t know about him. As you really looked what was going on in New York, an awful lot of musicians that are in New York came from L.A. They used to have this thing. They used to talk about West Coast Jazz. That was – that was Shorty Rogers. It wasn’t at the Hillcrest. What was happening at the Hillcrest, it was very ethnic.
Where was it located, the Hillcrest?
